title: 第17章 回归修仙界第18章 小女仆越来越香
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
一切准备妥当，秋生文才弄来了血腥之物，成功把蝙蝠从房梁上勾引下来，直接一把火把里面还在因为熬夜而补觉的外国友人吵醒了。
“嘤！
嘤！
嘤！
（就是你欺负师傅，烧死你，烧死你。
）”
青墨怀里抱着的小僵尸，看见外国吸血鬼，就把自己的小拳拳抓紧隔空挥舞，一直发出可爱的声音。
因为是正午时分，阳光充足，九叔他们看见了外国友人时眼神火热，里面那位看到九叔他们也是满脸笑容。
“九叔，现在正午时分，他怕阳光，咱们想办法让阳光照进去，来个活晒西洋咸鱼。”
“好，听你的。”
文才秋生本来想冲过去先把一些木板拆了，青墨拦住他们，把挂在小僵尸脖子上的炸药扔给他们。
“有炸药不用干嘛过去费那个力气？”
“对啊！”
青墨把教堂周围的空间都给封了，说晒咸鱼就要晒咸鱼。
文才秋生拿着炸药点上火就一股脑的扔进去，顿时火光四气，整个教堂直接被炸塌了半边，还有一小部分留有一点点阴影，青墨神念扫过，发现吸血鬼受了重伤，躲在废墟下。
“咱们进去看看，一定要把这个祸患给除了。”
“好”
“都小心点，咱们还不清楚它死没死，多注意身后，别被偷袭了。”
九叔对于外国友人格外执着，身先士卒先进去，文才秋生也跟随九叔的身影一起进去，青墨其实心里清楚刚刚踏入阴影旁边的废墟里吸血鬼就躲在里面。
就在九叔师徒三人翻看废墟找寻尸体的时候，青墨身后的废墟猛的爆炸开来，吸血鬼两只手抓紧青墨的双臂，嘴巴大开的对着青墨的脖子咬了下去。

突然吸血鬼满嘴的白牙全部蹦掉，咬在了不知道青墨手里不知道从哪得来的大铁棍上。
“咬人，咬鞋算什么本事，来试试我这根，够不够硬？过不过瘾？”
大铁棍的另一头已经被吸血鬼咬在嘴里，蹦碎了它满嘴的牙，青墨还觉得差点意思，故意把大铁棍往吸血鬼的嘴里捅了捅！
九叔他们听到声响回头看到了青墨对吸血鬼做的事情，顿时三人好像打通任督二脉一样，觉得以后可以试试。
经过昨晚他们发现自家的道术对吸血鬼没用之后，全部换成了物理攻击，文才秋生拿起废墟里的搬砖就冲上去一顿暴打，九叔弄了根和大腿一样粗的木棍也冲了上去。
“物理超度，恐怖如斯！
施主一路走好，阿门！
！”
青墨看着九叔他们和外国友人交谈得那么愉快，就先从废墟里出去了。
也把小僵尸抱出去，小小年纪的不能看这些暴力场面！
因为吸血鬼没了牙，九叔师徒真正放开了手脚，可怜的吸血鬼在一挑三的战斗中坚挺了两个多小时，不幸离世。
这边的剧情基本结束，青墨也准备离开了，在离开前请任家父女九叔师徒吃了一顿。
“九叔，我要走了，以后有时间的话，我会来拜访你的，临别前有些份礼物送给你，你滴一滴自己的血在这个戒指上就知道了。”
“秋生，文才你们也有，等你们回到义庄就知道了。”
“任老爷，记住我和你说的话，我帮你刻的玉佩可别丢了，只要你们任家行善积德，本本分分做人做事，保你们代代平安。”
青墨飞向天空消失在众人眼前，九叔心里早就知道他不简单，秋生文才任婷婷嘴巴大长，直到现在才知道青墨是神仙！
九叔师徒回到义庄，才发现有个小孩在这里。
“师傅！”
“你是谁家的小孩啊？怎么到义庄来了？”
“哎呀，师傅是我呀！

After everything was prepared, Qiu Shengwen got some bloody things, successfully lured the bats off the beams, and directly used a torch to wake up the foreign friends inside who were still catching up on sleep after staying up late.
"Hey!
Hum!
Hum!
(You bully the master, burn you to death, burn you to death.
)"
When the little zombie in Qing Mo's arms saw the foreign vampire, he clenched his little fists and waved them in the air, making cute sounds all the time.
Because it was noon and there was plenty of sunshine, Uncle Jiu and the others had bright eyes when they saw their foreign friends. The person inside was also smiling when he saw Uncle Jiu and the others.
"Uncle Jiu, it's noon now and he's afraid of the sun. Let's find a way to let the sun shine in and dry the salted Western fish alive."
"Okay, it's up to you."
Wen Cai Qiusheng originally wanted to rush over and tear down some wooden boards first, but Qing Mo stopped them and threw the explosives hanging around the little zombie's neck to them.
"Why bother going there if you don't have explosives?"
"Yes!"
Qing Mo sealed off the space around the church, saying that if you say you want to show off your salted fish, you must show off your salted fish.
Wencai Qiusheng lit the explosives on fire and threw them in. Suddenly, the fire was all over the place. Half of the entire church was destroyed by the explosion, and a small part was left with a little shadow. Qingmo's spiritual mind swept over and found that the vampire was seriously injured and hiding under the ruins.
"Let's go in and take a look, and we must get rid of this scourge."
"good"
"Be careful. We don't know if it is dead yet. Pay more attention behind you to avoid being attacked."
Uncle Jiu was particularly persistent with foreign friends and went in first. Qiu Sheng, a literary talent, also followed Uncle Jiu. In fact, Qing Mo knew in his heart that the vampire was hiding in the ruins next to the shadow just after he stepped into it.
Just as Uncle Jiu and his disciples were looking through the ruins in search of corpses, the ruins behind Qing Mo exploded violently. The vampire grabbed Qing Mo's arms with both hands and bit Qing Mo's neck with his mouth wide open.
Suddenly all the white teeth in the vampire's mouth popped out and bit down on the big iron rod that Qing Mo had obtained from who knows where.
"Bite people, shoe biting is nothing, come and try my dick, is it hard enough? Is it enough?"
The other end of the big iron rod had been bitten by the vampire, breaking its teeth. Qing Mo felt almost embarrassed and deliberately pushed the big iron rod into the vampire's mouth!
Uncle Jiu and the others heard the noise and turned around to see what Qing Mo was doing to the vampire. Suddenly the three of them seemed to have opened up the Ren and Du channels, and thought they could try it in the future.
After last night, they discovered that their Taoist skills were useless against vampires, so they all switched to physical attacks. Qiu Sheng, a literary talent, picked up the bricks from the ruins and rushed forward to beat them severely. Uncle Jiu got a wooden stick as thick as his thigh and rushed forward.
"Physical transcendence is so terrifying!
Good luck to the donor, Amen!
! "
Qing Mo saw Uncle Jiu and the others chatting so happily with their foreign friends, so he walked out of the ruins first.
Take the little zombies out too, young ones can’t watch these violent scenes!
Because the vampire had no teeth, Uncle Jiu's master and apprentice really let go of their hands and feet. The poor vampire stood firm in the one-on-three battle for more than two hours, and unfortunately passed away.
The plot here is basically over, Qing Mo is also ready to leave, and before leaving, he invites the father and daughter of the Ren family, Uncle Jiu, master and apprentice, to have a meal.
"Uncle Jiu, I'm leaving. If I have time in the future, I will come to visit you. I have some gifts for you before I leave. You can put a drop of your own blood on this ring and you will know."
"Qiusheng, you also have literary talents. You will know when you return to Yizhuang."
"Master Ren, remember what I said to you. Don't lose the jade pendant I carved for you. As long as you, the Ren family, do good deeds and accumulate virtues, behave as you should, I will keep you safe from generation to generation."
Qingmo flew into the sky and disappeared in front of everyone. Uncle Jiu had long known in his heart that he was not simple. Qiu Shengwen only allowed Tingting to have a big mouth. It was only now that he knew that Qingmo was not simple.Mo is a god!
Master Jiu Shu and his apprentice returned to Yizhuang, only to find that there was a child here.
"Master!"
"Whose child are you? Why are you here in Yizhuang?"
"Oh, it's me, the master!
